topic: Forward Deployed Engineering from First Principles to Enterprise Delivery
audience: Software engineers who can write functions and call a web API; no ML background assumed. Some Python is needed.
outcome: Scope a customer problem, integrate with its systems, build and evaluate an AI feature, deploy it into a restricted customer environment, hand it over, and explain the trade-offs in an interview.

running_example.name: Basket Bazaar grocery delivery issues (fictional customer)
running_example.why: Everyone has ordered groceries or food and received the wrong item; it grows from one CSV to many stores, cities and customers.
running_example.evolution: a messy orders CSV -> an API that triages one missing item -> evals and auth -> a Compose deployment -> per-store tenancy and a handover

llm.why: The course's work is building AI features for customers; a few lessons call the real model, recorded once and replayed without a key.

stack.role: the model behind the LLM lessons
the customer environment: network, proxy, services
the mock customer API and the course app
stack.adoption: the default Python API framework in current job postings and official docs
the validation layer used by FastAPI and most current LLM SDKs

stack.role: regression tests for evals and APIs

datasets.name: orders.csv
datasets.what: a few hundred synthetic grocery orders with duplicate rows, missing items and mixed units, for the delivery-exception story
datasets.generated: made by the lesson 05 code with a fixed random seed; no real customer data

app.name: Basket Bazaar delivery-issues service
app.what: a local FastAPI backend plus a one-page web UI that triages grocery delivery issues (missing, wrong or late items), run with uvicorn

steps.title: A local triage API
steps.adds: one endpoint that triages one delivery issue with a model call and checked output, plus a web page

steps.title: Storage, tests and error handling
steps.adds: stored delivery issues, tests, retries and clear error responses

steps.title: Observability, evals and security
steps.adds: structured logs and a trace, an eval gate, a service token and per-customer config

steps.title: Finish and run it
steps.adds: one run command, full tests, README
